notes.title: Devlog #03: Sneak Peek Video of the Full Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/5fda0a80c3356d2f9c5b4b5d8018e2753daee3f1.png[/img]

[h1]Hello![/h1]

How are you? XD

Lately we’ve been joining lots of online events, so it’s pretty hectic for us these days. But we’re glad that we’ve been receiving lots of love, also from [b]Steam Game Festival: Summer Edition[/b] last month. Thanks to everyone who came and watched the stream!

Before the Steam Game Festival, we also participated in [i]Wholesome Direct[/i] where we showcased exclusive footage from the full game of [b]When the Past was Around[/b]. We thought maybe we can share the video we submitted here, too!

Check out the full-game footage on the video below!
https://youtu.be/ErAc0fK8DJU

And here’s the link to the full direct video.
https://youtu.be/AwCNzOPR8Ck?t=1088

Soooo… After watching the video, are you excited? Tell us in the comment section!

Oh, right! We also have some news from [b]When the Past was Around[/b]!
The game will be published in Japan by awesome team from Chorus Worldwide and they will also help us with the release and distribution on Nintendo Switch eShop, PS4, and Xbox One! So, yes! We’re coming to consoles as well! Yay yaaayyyy!

Last but not least, we finally have our own Twitter account!
So please follow us on Twitter! <3

TWITTER : http://twitter.com/WPWAgame

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/53cf9667bc7cd2d1324267c6a4dc2bbe83e9106c.png[/img]

[h1]Cross-Promo Time![/h1]

And please also wishlist this upcoming game from our studio, [b]A Space for the Unbound[/b]!
A slice-of-life adventure game set in the late 90s rural Indonesia that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers.

If you love When the Past was Around, you will probably love this game, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_For_The_Unbound/

That’s is for now! We’ll see you on the next devlog!

With love,
Owl Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35971849/66643bb8ae0e6f02ad52c182224d9ae014d39591.png[/img]
